criteria.criterion: A portable test in `tests/unit/test_api_surface_gate.py` runs under `make test` with no CI-provider dependency and asserts the live public Python API surface matches the committed baseline `tests/unit/api_surface_baseline.json`, failing on any removed/renamed public symbol or changed signature.

The gate derives the surface from the pinned source-of-truth rule stated in Approach (`MODULES` public members via `__all__`-or-owned). Oracle: `test_baseline_file_is_committed_and_wellformed` asserts every pinned module appears in the baseline.

citation.description: Referencing commit 521318a7d1076ff7d0f15e3eace303655899afb1 deletes test_reuse_surface_doc.py (-92 lines); test_api_surface_gate.py contains test_subsumes_signing_signatures, test_subsumes_prompt_library_surface, test_subsumes_runner_and_contract_surface, test_subsumes_workflow_executor_surface.

criteria.criterion: The hardcoded-subset assertions in `test_reuse_surface_doc.py` are removed and subsumed with no loss of coverage. Oracle: that file no longer exists; the four `test_subsumes_*` tests assert the same signing/prompt/runner/workflow signatures are guarded.

An intentional surface change is accommodated by the documented `--update` step, exercised by a test. Oracle: `test_intentional_change_is_accommodated_by_updating_the_baseline` shows a stale baseline fails `--check` and passes after `--update`.

RED→GREEN: a test proves the gate catches an injected surface drift (added/removed public symbol, renamed param). Oracle: `test_check_trips_when_a_public_symbol_is_removed` / `_added` / `test_check_trips_when_a_signature_changes` assert exit 1 and the named drift line.
